# Set Up
```{r Setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	echo = TRUE,
	message = TRUE,
	warning = TRUE
)
```

```{r Load libraries, include=FALSE, results='hide'}
# Data handling
library(tidyverse)

# Statistical analysis
library(broom)
library(effectsize)

# Tables
library(gt)
library(gtsummary)
```

## Data Preparation
```{r Data import, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE, results='hide'}
# Read data
df <- read.csv("raw_data.csv")
```

```{r Data preparation, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE, results='hide'}
# Calculate change scores and prepare data
df_processed <- df %>%
  rename(
    pre_score = pre.score,
    post_score = post.score
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate change in health score
    delta_score = post_score - pre_score,
    
    # Create factor variables with appropriate levels
    LLM = factor(LLM),
    Intervention = factor(Intervention, 
                         levels = c("neutral (brief)", "accident", "ambush", 
                                   "disaster", "interpersonal", "military")),
    Budget = factor(Budget, levels = c(27, 54, 108)),
    
    # Create condition identifier for the 45 unique conditions
    condition = paste(LLM, Budget, Intervention, sep = "_"),
    
    # Binary indicator for anxiety vs control
    is_anxiety = ifelse(Intervention == "neutral (brief)", "Control", "Anxiety")
  )

# Separate anxiety conditions from control
df_anxiety <- df_processed %>% 
  filter(is_anxiety != "Control")

df_control <- df_processed %>% 
  filter(is_anxiety == "Control")
```

# Analysis

## Results Section 1: Condition-Level Analysis
```{r Condition level tests, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Perform paired t-tests for each unique condition (45 conditions)
condition_results <- df_anxiety %>%
  group_by(LLM, Budget, Intervention) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_pre = mean(pre_score),
    sd_pre = sd(pre_score),
    mean_post = mean(post_score),
    sd_post = sd(post_score),
    mean_delta = mean(delta_score),
    sd_delta = sd(delta_score),
    
    # Paired t-test (one-sided: H1: delta < 0)
    t_statistic = t.test(delta_score, mu = 0, alternative = "less")$statistic,
    t_p_value = t.test(delta_score, mu = 0, alternative = "less")$p.value,
    
    # Wilcoxon signed-rank test (one-sided)
    wilcox_statistic = wilcox.test(delta_score, mu = 0, alternative = "less")$statistic,
    wilcox_p_value = wilcox.test(delta_score, mu = 0, alternative = "less")$p.value,
    
    # 95% CI for delta
    ci_lower = t.test(delta_score)$conf.int[1],
    ci_upper = t.test(delta_score)$conf.int[2],
    
    # Cohen's d (paired)
    cohens_d = mean(delta_score) / sd(delta_score),
    
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # Add FDR correction for multiple comparisons
  mutate(
    t_p_adj = p.adjust(t_p_value, method = "BH"),
    wilcox_p_adj = p.adjust(wilcox_p_value, method = "BH")
  )

# Display results table
condition_results %>%
  select(LLM, Budget, Intervention, n, mean_delta, sd_delta, 
         cohens_d, t_p_value, t_p_adj) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Condition-Level Analysis Results",
    subtitle = "45 Unique Conditions (3 LLMs × 3 Budgets × 5 Interventions)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(mean_delta, sd_delta, cohens_d), decimals = 3) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(t_p_value, t_p_adj), decimals = 4) %>%
  cols_label(
    mean_delta = "Mean Δ",
    sd_delta = "SD Δ",
    cohens_d = "Cohen's d",
    t_p_value = "p-value",
    t_p_adj = "p-value (FDR)"
  )
```

```{r LLM by Budget interaction, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
  )
```

## Results Section 4: Anxiety vs. Control Comparison
```{r Anxiety vs Control, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Compare all anxiety conditions to neutral control
# Using Welch's t-test for unequal variances

# Overall comparison
overall_comparison <- t.test(
  df_anxiety$delta_score,
  df_control$delta_score,
  alternative = "less",
  var.equal = FALSE
)

# Calculate effect size for overall comparison (manual calculation)
pooled_sd <- sqrt((sd(df_anxiety$delta_score)^2 + sd(df_control$delta_score)^2) / 2)
overall_cohens_d <- (mean(df_anxiety$delta_score) - mean(df_control$delta_score)) / pooled_sd

# Summary statistics
comparison_summary <- data.frame(
  Group = c("Anxiety (All)", "Control (Neutral)"),
  n = c(nrow(df_anxiety), nrow(df_control)),
  mean_delta = c(mean(df_anxiety$delta_score), mean(df_control$delta_score)),
  sd_delta = c(sd(df_anxiety$delta_score), sd(df_control$delta_score))
)

# Display comparison results
comparison_summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Anxiety vs. Control Comparison",
    subtitle = "All anxiety conditions (n=2250) vs. neutral control (n=450)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(columns = c(mean_delta, sd_delta), decimals = 3) %>%
  tab_footnote(
    footnote = paste0(
      "Welch's t-test: t = ", round(overall_comparison$statistic, 3),
      ", p = ", round(overall_comparison$p.value, 4),
      ", Cohen's d = ", round(overall_cohens_d, 3)
    ),
    locations = cells_title()
  )
```
```{r Visual, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Prepare data for plotting
plot_data <- df_anxiety %>%
  group_by(LLM, Budget) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_delta = mean(delta_score),
    se_delta = sd(delta_score) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Create the bar plot
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Budget, y = mean_delta, fill = LLM)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.8) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_delta - se_delta, ymax = mean_delta + se_delta),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.9), width = 0.25) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("ChatGPT 5" = "#1f77b4",
                               "Claude 3.5-Sonnet" = "#ff7f0e", 
                               "Gemini 2.5" = "#2ca02c")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-0.14, 0.01), breaks = seq(-0.14, 0, 0.02)) +
  labs(x = "Shopping Budget ($)",
       y = "Change in Basket Health Score (BHS)",
       fill = "LLM") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "gray", fill = NA, size = 0.5)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("27" = "Low ($27)", "54" = "Medium ($54)", "108" = "High ($108)"))

# Save last plot as PNG
ggsave("Figure 3.png", width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
```
